home.metaTitle: RideKmer — Car rental in Douala and Yaoundé
home.metaDescription: Rent a car with or without a chauffeur in Cameroon. Transparent XAF prices, Mobile Money payment, verified vehicles.

hero.eyebrow: Douala · Yaoundé · and more cities soon
hero.title: The car you need, when you need it.
hero.subtitle: Self-drive or chauffeur-driven, by the day, week or month. Verified vehicles, transparent prices in XAF, MTN Mobile Money and Orange Money accepted.

verified.title: Verified vehicles
verified.body: Every car is reviewed, insured and inspected before it goes live. Documents are tracked and expiring ones are flagged automatically.

support.title: Support in French and English

howItWorks.title: How RideKmer works
howItWorks.intro: Four steps from search to return, with everything documented on your phone.

search.title: 1. Search and compare
search.body: Choose your city, dates and whether you want a chauffeur. Compare prices, deposits and kilometre allowances.

verify.title: 2. Verify your identity
verify.body: Upload your identity document and driving licence once. Verified customers can book instantly on eligible vehicles.

pay.title: 3. Book and pay
pay.body: Pay the rental and the security deposit with MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money or card. Your booking is confirmed only when the payment is verified.

drive.title: 4. Pickup, drive, return
drive.body: A joint inspection with photos at pickup and return protects both sides. Your deposit is released after the return inspection.

partner.title: Turn your vehicle into income
partner.intro: Entrust your vehicle to RideKmer or manage it yourself on the marketplace. Either way you see every booking, every franc earned and every maintenance expense.

managed.title: Fully managed
managed.body: RideKmer handles bookings, customer contact, inspections, maintenance coordination and payouts. You approve major expenses and receive monthly statements.

marketplace.title: Self-managed marketplace
marketplace.body: You keep control of handovers and customer contact while RideKmer provides verification, payment collection, contracts and payouts.

requirements.title: What we need from you
items: Vehicle registration certificate (carte grise) and proof of ownership
Valid motor insurance covering rental use
Owner identity document and proof of address (company registration for companies)
Consent to the installation of a GPS tracker
A Mobile Money or bank account for payouts

earnings.title: Earnings and commissions
earnings.body: RideKmer retains a commission on each rental (configurable per arrangement) and deducts approved maintenance or damage costs. Everything is itemised in your statements.

chauffeur.title: Chauffeur-driven rentals
chauffeur.intro: Professional drivers who know Douala, Yaoundé and the roads between them. Ideal for business trips, events, airport transfers and upcountry travel.
benefits: Daily chauffeur fee shown upfront in XAF
No driving-licence verification required for the customer
Fuel and tolls agreed in the rental contract

corporate.title: Mobility for companies and organisations
corporate.intro: Pool vehicles for your teams, monthly invoicing, consolidated reporting and dedicated support.
benefits: Vehicles with chauffeur for executives and visitors

longTerm.title: Long-term rental and leasing
longTerm.intro: From one month to several years, with maintenance, insurance renewals and technical inspections handled by RideKmer.
benefits: Monthly rates lower than daily rates
Replacement vehicle during major repairs (subject to availability)
Clear end-of-term inspection and deposit settlement

items.q: Which documents do I need to rent?
items.a: A valid identity document (national ID card or passport) and a driving licence held for at least two years for self-drive rentals. Chauffeur-driven rentals only require an identity document.
With MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money or a bank card. The booking is confirmed only when the payment is verified by the provider, never on a simple redirect.

items.q: How does the security deposit work?
items.a: The deposit is debited with the rental and refunded after the return inspection, minus any agreed deductions. Mobile Money deposits are real debits, not holds.
Yes, from your booking page, subject to the vehicle's availability and the payment of the extension.

items.q: What happens if the car breaks down?
items.a: Report the incident from the app. Our operations team coordinates assistance and a replacement vehicle where possible.

Vehicles are equipped with commercial GPS trackers for security and recovery. This is disclosed in the rental agreement and the privacy notice. Location data is accessible only to authorised staff and every access is logged.
Yes. The cancellation policy describes the free-cancellation window and the fees that apply afterwards.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: RideKmer operates a car-rental, leasing and fleet-management platform in Cameroon. This notice explains how we process personal data of customers, vehicle owners, chauffeurs and staff.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: Identity and contact details, identity and driving-licence documents, payment references (never Mobile Money PINs or full card numbers), booking history, inspection photos, incident reports, and vehicle location data from GPS trackers.

sections.title: Vehicle location data
sections.body: Vehicles may carry commercial GPS trackers. Location data is used for vehicle security, recovery and incident handling. Only authorised staff can access it, every access is recorded, and data is retained for a limited, configurable period.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can request a copy of your data or its deletion from your account settings, subject to legal retention obligations for contracts, invoices and incidents.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Privacy requests: use the contact form and choose the subject "Other".

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.body: The general terms and conditions governing the use of RideKmer, bookings, payments, deposits, liability and disputes will be published here after legal review.

rentalPolicy.title: Rental policy
rentalPolicy.body: Eligibility (age, licence seniority), kilometre allowances, fuel policy, late-return fees, cleaning fees, cross-border restrictions and incident obligations will be detailed here after legal review.

cancellationPolicy.title: Cancellation policy
cancellationPolicy.body: Free cancellation up to {hours} hours before pickup (placeholder). Later cancellations retain a configurable share of the rental. No-shows are not refunded. Final rules pending legal review.
